text:
toni: quick flag onboarding Nebula7b (int4) - short prompts look fine but start seeing subtle semantic drift around 900-1100 tokens. repeating "then"/"also" patterns. attaching hf sample.

sam: any conversion flags that changed from our usual flow? which convert tool/version?

toni: convert v2.1 with head_fuse enabled, rotary_mode=auto, kv_pack=compressed. tokenizer converted with pack-tokenmap=true.

eric: compressed kv_pack + head_fuse is a risky combo. can you dump kv-cache comparison vs fp16 baseline for a long prompt? also compare rotary sin/cos stats per head.

toni: quick dump: `python tools/kv_diff.py --model nebula7b --quant int4 --ref fp16 --out /tmp/diff.log` attached. pattern: per-head phase mismatch accumulates, but it's not uniform across heads - heads 2,3 flip sign after 768 tokens.

maya: could be head-dim ordering during pack. head_fuse concatenates heads which can change internal stride assumpt. If rotary tables created before fusing they may be misaligned.

convert-bot: starting conversion-check job nebula7b-int4-compat (runner=ded-convert-4). logs: https://ci.internal/logs/conv/7821

sam: I ran a local check: reconstructed sin/cos arrays on the quantized artifacts reveal that table length equals total_head_dim but indexing during runtime expects per-head contiguous blocks. Our kernel has fallback that assumes per-head contiguous ordering unless flagged. That creates a mis-index when head_fuse toggled.

toni: repro snippet: ```bash
# reproduce drift
rdm-gen --model /mnt/models/nebula7b/int4 --prompt long_story.txt --max-tokens 1500 --stream
```

Output shows coherent until ~920 tokens then lexical collapse to short-cycles.

eric: try re-quant with `--no-head-fuse --rotary-explicit` and also preserve tokenmap padding (we've seen padding folding cause aliasing with longctx).

convert-bot: conversion job finished. artifact: https://ci.internal/artifacts/7821/nebula7b-int4-noheadfuse.tgz

toni: reran the long story - no drift up to 2k tokens, embeddings remain within 0.02 cos sim vs fp16. Looks like head_fuse was the culprit.

sam: action items: 1) add a convert-time assert that checks rotary table indexing matches runtime kernel layout 2) default convert to preserve per-head ordering unless explicitly requested with validated kernel 3) add longctx smoke (2k) to int4 onboarding matrix.

maya: and tokenizer follow-up: when tokenmap packing is enabled, we should emit mapping table in artifact metadata and run a quick sentinel/pad collision scan. filing a ticket.

toni: will open PR to update convert docs + add CI smoke. tagging @sam for review. thanks all :clap:
